brainlife.name: neuro/hcp/freesurferpost
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Cortical surface mapping in fs_LR space (e.g. Fukutomi et al. cortex tissue mapping).

**Not for:** Apps needing MSMAll spheres or fsaverage_LR32k when the folder lacks them.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.hcp.freesurferpost.json
